decision_register.finding: product.aion_development_team already supplies the server and both client editions. Consolidate three product aliases into that package for commercial statements; retain separate software_edition references for implementation facts. Do not create three more customer offerings.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Accept the package as the canonical commercial identity and review each alias reference by role.

decision_register.topic: BPI external identity and package membership
decision_register.finding: Eleven third-party source records map to eight suggested external identities if the three BPI client/server technical aliases join external_product.bpi_client_server. Preserve the client/server edition distinctions and direct package membership; independent licences/receipts remain independent. A ninth external identity describes DRI CP/M separately from the retained Logix cartridge offering (D15).
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Confirm consolidation of the BPI client/server commercial identity; retain its three implementation editions.

decision_register.finding: AIONix, AIONix Server, AIONix2 and the CP/M networking edition have technical definitions and bundled use but no independently specified customer package. The baseline CP/M cartridge is now retained separately under D15. The networking cartridge also exists as device.rom_cartridge.cpm_aurelia_networking and is included in product.aurelia_network_upgrade; this alone does not establish a separately sold cartridge.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Review the four remaining OS/package candidates. Apply the same separation of DRI software rights, technical edition and Logix physical medium; do not infer a standalone networking cartridge or transfer software ownership from engineering responsibility labels.

decision_register.topic: Standalone peripherals versus parts of kits
decision_register.finding: Eighteen device-linked product aliases have incomplete standalone-offer evidence. This includes monitor variants, video cards, keyboard, FlexiDisk, network cards and hubs. Inclusion in a computer or upgrade BOM is not itself proof of a separate orderable product.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Identify which are separately offered; retain those IDs and specify their contents. Redirect the remaining aliases to their existing devices.

decision_register.finding: CP/M and AIONix editions exist, the suite is released in event.ncc82_graphics_mouse, and Mouse Learning Pack already supplies it. An additional standalone edition/product entitlement is not explicit.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Confirm standalone editions, one selectable-edition package, or software included only in the existing Mouse Learning Pack.

decision_register.finding: service_academy_before_you_buy likely overlaps the concrete two-day academy_course_1. service_academy_regular_courses is a broad label beside four concrete courses. The other courses retain distinct durations and must not inherit Fundamentals purchase credit by accident.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Reconcile the before-you-buy service with Fundamentals, and replace the regular-course umbrella with concrete course references or process scope.

decision_register.finding: Customer Care, Professional Support, Professional Business On-site, Academy customer-site courses and two commercial-developer licences lack enough evidence to settle independent offering versus included entitlement or policy.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Confirm their offering scope and provider before retaining them as products. No prices, new entitlements or launches are inferred.

decision_register.finding: service_component_licensing is an unreferenced name with an empty specification. OEM sales structures are explicitly outside this change.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Retire this catalogue placeholder in a later reviewed proposal while preserving its original description in migration evidence; create no replacement OEM model now.

decision_register.finding: comdex82_reference_hardware has a full product composition but its description calls it reference hardware and leaves shipment/qualification pending.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Confirm whether it is independently offered or only a demonstration/reference configuration before final catalogue enforcement.

decision_register.topic: AION C IDE identity and first launch
decision_register.finding: The current product is AIONix-specific but is referenced by the 1978 Aurelia and 1980 Artemis campaigns/events. Other CP/M developer products already exist.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Review the 1978 references against Simple C/SDK evidence; do not mechanically choose the earliest campaign or invent a missing historical edition.

decision_register.topic: 64 KB module versus installable memory kit
decision_register.finding: product.ram_64kb_module supplies one device.ram_64kb_x32. That device describes matched-pair installation, while product.ram_256kb_bank supplies two 128 KB modules. A single module could be a spare rather than a complete upgrade.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Clarify the 64 KB offering role and population. Do not automatically change quantity or confuse it with the old eight-chip device.artemis_ram_module_64kb.

decision_register.finding: Four family products have 37 active foundation reference occurrences. Some references express broad compatibility or ecosystem scope rather than a list of current SKUs.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Use concrete offerings only where they express the intended scope; otherwise use direct technical subjects or retain the scope in the owning record text. Never create a replacement artificial family entity.

decision_register.finding: All ten designated campaign launch events fall inside their process periods, but event.autodesk_comdex is currently owned by process.autodesk_development. NCC 1978 correctly owns two launches through a sessions subprocess.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Reconcile public launch ownership in phase 6 without duplicating ownership or inventing dates. No ownership changes belong to phase 1.

decision_register.topic: Remove chip promotion from catalogue cleanup
decision_register.finding: campaign.ncc1980 and its execution process include product.part_aion_4164; campaign.ncc1983 includes product.part_era2_12mhz. These are technical parts, not customer offerings.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Do not simply replace marketing subject IDs with base_part IDs and preserve chip promotion. Keep necessary engineering facts in technical context; do not infer OEM campaigns or sales.

decision_register.topic: CP/M software rights versus Logix physical cartridge
decision_register.finding: The user identifies the physical CP/M ROM cartridge as a Logix/AION offering produced under DRI licence. device.rom_cartridge.cpm_aurelia already names Logix as provider and contains software_edition.cpm_aurelia plus ROM, PCB/connector and shell/label parts. agreement.dri_cpm assigns ownership of the resulting CP/M and its enhancements to DRI; technical responsibility labels are not ownership grants.
decision_register.recommended_next_decision: Retain product.software_cpm_aurelia and redefine it as the Logix cartridge offering. Introduce a separate descriptive external DRI software identity, preserve the software edition and existing cartridge BOM, and allocate all 12 incoming product references by meaning. Confirm packaging and replacement/upgrade availability later without inventing separate sale or dates.

missing_or_incomplete_offerings.recommendation: Define a customer-facing Aurelia 16 KB expansion if separately offered, preserving the existing board and compatible socket. No current product targets this device. Its launch can share Aurelia campaign/event after review; no new launch is implied.
Both existing offering compositions already supply one Business Tools cartridge. Retain and enrich those records; do not create another cartridge SKU just because the device also exists.

missing_or_incomplete_offerings.finding: Eight existing commercial identities need compositions
missing_or_incomplete_offerings.recommendation: Keep the eight current product IDs, define their supplied contents and direct links, and preserve their device BOMs. For the CP/M-80 module, explicit separate-sale evidence is in event.artemis_launch prose even though the event has no exact reference to its product ID.

The 128 KB module is already in the two-module 256 KB offering. Larger 256 KB modules occur in complete systems; create additional upgrade/spare offerings only when their customer-facing package is explicitly chosen. Do not manufacture a SKU for every process-node revision.

missing_or_incomplete_offerings.finding: Packaging decisions, not automatic new products
missing_or_incomplete_offerings.recommendation: Resolve D03/D05 before creating standalone OS or entertainment packages; included software remains a technical definition even without a separate product.

missing_or_incomplete_offerings.finding: Direct external host identity is absent
missing_or_incomplete_offerings.recommendation: Add a simple Apple II external identity when migrating direct host/ecosystem relationships. Logix Apple II cards remain Logix products; do not classify them as external.

missing_or_incomplete_offerings.finding: Further external identities may be needed for explicit existing story subjects
missing_or_incomplete_offerings.recommendation: Consider Disk II, the Apple–Peachtree business package and the scenario-specific IBM business PC as separate descriptive external subjects where direct references are needed. Keep IBM supplier/OS unspecified as the story does. Do not replace it with historical MS-DOS/5150 assumptions.

missing_or_incomplete_offerings.finding: Do not turn vague market classes or every supplier part into products
missing_or_incomplete_offerings.recommendation: Osborne-class/Multiplan-class observations do not establish exact offered configurations. A purchased Seagate mechanism does not automatically need a second external commercial record. Add external identities only for directly modelled commercial/partner/competition subjects.

missing_or_incomplete_offerings.finding: Retained CP/M cartridge offering needs commercial definition, not a duplicate technical BOM
missing_or_incomplete_offerings.recommendation: Define the retained product around one cartridge device at an explicit composition version; retain the existing device-to-software and base-part links. Keep DRI rights in the agreement and external description. Do not count the licensed software a second time as another physical cartridge or invent royalty amounts, licence counts, exact ROM technology/capacity, separate-sale terms or launch dates.
